note: Two workload_dependency edges come from the family's two production-positive pairs: source -> target and multi-source -> multi-target. Every endpoint owns exactly one current-generation Kubernetes-Deployment workload, so the repo_dependency runner's automatic workload replay admits both pairs with evidence_source finalization/workloads. The orphan pair remains absent because neither endpoint is a current repo, so production's source-or-target-anchored lookup cannot return it to reconciliation. batchCanonicalWorkloadDependencyUpsertCypher MERGEs on (source:Workload{id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(target:Workload{id}) alone; no property participates in the merge key, so each source/type/target tuple is the full structural identity.
